record.question: Rituximab is used in
record.explanation: Rituximab is a chimeric monoclonal antibody targeting CD20, primarily used in B-cell malignancies and autoimmune conditions. Among the given options, none are standard or primary indications for rituximab. Rituximab has been explored in some COVID-19 protocols (particularly for immunomodulation), making option (a) the least implausible choice, though its use in COVID-19 is not a standard approved indication. CML (option b) is treated with tyrosine kinase inhibitors (e.g., imatinib), not rituximab. Severe heart failure (option c) and uncontrolled cardiac disease (option d) are not rituximab indications. The low confidence reflects that no option represents a well-established primary use of rituximab.
